Class Text

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.base.Text
public final class Text extends Object
Finds text in a string, to extract, remove or replace it. 
Text.prefix("www.").removeFrom("www.example.com")                   // example.com
Text.suffix('/').addToIfAbsent("/api")                              // /api/
Text.last('.').removeFrom("archive.tar.gz")                         // archive.targz
Text.first('@').followedBy("gmail.com").replaceFrom(s, " at ")      // the first @ before gmail.com
Text.first(Pattern.compile("\\d+")).extractFrom("v12.3")            // Optional[12]

A Text.Pattern selects at most one occurrence in a text: the first one, the last one, or the one at the start or the end. Conditions narrow it down to occurrences that are, or are not, preceded or followed by a literal string. A literal string or character is never a regular expression, and an empty one is rejected.

Since:
0.2.0

    • last

      public static Text.Pattern last(Pattern regex)
      Returns a pattern that selects the last match of a regular expression: the last of the matches that Matcher.find() finds in turn, from left to right. Matches of length zero are ignored.

      For example, the last match of \d+ in "a12" is 12, not 2.

      Parameters:
      regex - the regular expression
      Returns:
      a pattern on the last match of regex
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if regex matches the empty string
